messages:
jules: Hey team — quick triage: nightly snapshot job for db-prod failed to mount: 'decrypt failed: AccessDenied'. Cloud KMS shows no Decrypt events for the CMK during window. Anybody seen silent-deny behavior from the proxy?
audit-bot: Alert: SNAPSHOT_DECRYPT_FAIL detected for snapshot s-prod-2026-05-02-03. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/snapshot-decrypt-failures
omar: We rolled an RBAC prune that removed a legacy role binding for `snapshot-uploader@redwood.iam` last night. Could be related if our key policy references that principal.
rebecca: If proxy denies, we won't see Decrypt in KMS logs. Check proxy: `/var/log/kms-proxy/proxy.log` around 03:02 — filter for request ids.
jules: pulled proxy log: `2026-05-02T03:02:11Z WARN principal=snapshot-uploader mapping=not-found -> 403`. So mapping missed.
ops-jen: Also saw an object-store audit gap: storage write events exist but encryption metadata header `x-rr-encrypt-meta` missing on one multipart part. Could be uploader v2 bug where metadata isn't set when temp file path is used. GH: #10012 opened.
omar: For short-term restore: propose creating a time-bound grant for the uploader principal and re-running the restore. Also add a proxy rule to fallback to a deny-but-log path that forwards attempted principal+key to SIEM.
rebecca: Agreed. I'll apply temp grant (5m) and run smoke decrypt: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://kms-proxy.internal/v1/decrypt -d '{"key":"ck-backups","ciphertext":"<ct>"}'`
audit-bot: Temporary grant created by rebecca (expires in 00:05:00).
jules: restore retried, 6/6 shards recovered. One shard hit `timeout fetching CEK` during grant propagation but recovered after second attempt.
omar: Follow-ups: 1) Update RBAC rename checklist to include key-policy alias reconciliation and uid fallback; 2) Add integration test that renames SA and asserts KMS Decrypt audit events appear; 3) Patch uploader to atomically write encryption metadata alongside multipart parts.
ops-jen: For the tmpfile vuln: short-term mitigation set TMPDIR to `/var/opt/backups/tmp` with 0700 perms and ensure immediate unlink; long-term: switch to in-memory streaming encrypt pipeline (tracking in roadmap).
jules: Also: add alert rule when a backup-service principal has auth activity but zero KMS Decrypt events in 10m. That should catch proxy rejections earlier.
audit-bot: Post-incident tasks created: @rebecca apply durable grant mapping, @omar add test and checklist updates, @ops-jen attach vuln PR. ETA 72h.
jules: Thanks all. We'll do a quick blameless postmortem tomorrow. :thumbsup:
